name: whatsapp-web
description: Your personal WhatsApp through WhatsApp Web in a headless browser: read chats and messages, send text and files (low volume, rate limited)

nodes.title: Log in to WhatsApp Web
nodes.description: Open a visible browser window with the WhatsApp Web QR code and wait until it is scanned (WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link a device). Later runs reuse the saved session headlessly.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for WhatsApp Web to load and the QR code to be scanned, in total

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: WhatsApp Web status
nodes.description: Report whether WhatsApp Web is logged_in, needs_login (QR code shown) or loading, plus today's send count.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List WhatsApp chats
nodes.description: List chats from the top of the WhatsApp chat list: name, last message preview, time and unread count.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Search WhatsApp chats
nodes.description: Search chats and contacts by name or number with the WhatsApp search box; returns the matching chat and contact rows (each with `kind`), without section headers or message hits.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Read WhatsApp messages
nodes.description: Read the last messages of a chat (by phone number or exact chat name): id, from_me, sender, time, text and delivery status. Opening a chat marks it as read on your phone.

phone.description: Phone number starting with + or 00 and the country code, e.g. "+62 812 3456 789" (a national number such as "0812..." is refused). Works for numbers not in the chat list. Pass this or chat_name.

chat_name.description: Exact chat name as shown in WhatsApp (saved contact name or group name); refused when two chats share the name. Pass this or phone.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp message
nodes.description: Send a text message from your personal WhatsApp to a phone number or an existing chat (exact name). Rate limited; confirms the message appears as sent.

phone.description: Phone number starting with + or 00 and the country code, e.g. "+62 812 3456 789" (a national number such as "0812..." is refused). Works for numbers not in the chat list. Pass this or chat_name.

chat_name.description: Exact chat name as shown in WhatsApp (saved contact name or group name); refused when two chats share the name. Pass this or phone.

text.description: Message text; line breaks are kept

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp file
nodes.description: Send a photo, video or document (local path inside WHATSAPP_WEB_ALLOWED_FILE_DIRS, or an https URL) with an optional caption to a phone number or an existing chat.

phone.description: Phone number starting with + or 00 and the country code, e.g. "+62 812 3456 789" (a national number such as "0812..." is refused). Works for numbers not in the chat list. Pass this or chat_name.

chat_name.description: Exact chat name as shown in WhatsApp (saved contact name or group name); refused when two chats share the name. Pass this or phone.

file.description: Absolute local path or https URL

as_document.description: Send images/videos as a document (no compression)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
